newsitem.title: GERMANY: Three Turks dead after suspected arson in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Three Turks dead after suspected arson in Germany.

text.p: Three members of a Turkish family died after fire broke out in their apartment in the west German town of Krefeld overnight and investigators believe the blaze was started deliberately, police said on Monday.

A police spokesman said a flammable substance had been found close to the entrance of the third-floor flat. Prosecutors and murder squad detectives had begun investigations but there was no evidence to suggest a racially motivated attack, he said.
Two of the victims -- all members of the Demir family -- died as result of jumping from the apartment, in a high-rise block in the town centre.

The 41-year-old mother died on the scene while her 19-year-old daughter died later in hospital as a result of her injuries. Firefighters found the body of a third member of the family, a 17-year-old youth who had suffocated, in the flat.
Two female members of the family, both aged 15, also jumped from the flat and were in hospital with life-threatening injuries, police said.
Around 30 residents in the block were evacuated from their homes and four people received treatment for smoke inhalation.
